Game Overview

Pixel Panic puts players into a arcade experience centered on dodge and weave through waves of pixelated chaos in Pixel Panic. Navigate past relentless Bats with precision taps or clicks. It's a thrilling test of reflexes and speed—stay alert and avoid getting hit in this nostalgic, fast-paced throwback to classic arcade fun.
